name: What kind of information should I include in my knowledge base for GEO optimization?

mainEntity.name: What kind of information should I include in my knowledge base for GEO optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: For effective GEO optimization, your knowledge base should include precise business addresses, service areas, local phone numbers, and hours of operation for each location. It should also feature location-specific content like local landmarks, directions, and details about services offered uniquely in certain geographic regions. Ensure consistency across all digital properties, including Google Business Profile, social media, and your website.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include precise business addresses, service areas, local phone numbers, hours, and location-specific content for each site.
